title: Coordinate differences form a weakly regular sequence after a flat polynomial base change
statement: Let $R$ and $A$ be commutative rings, let $d\in\mathbf N$, and let $\psi:R[X_0,\ldots,X_{d-1}]\to A$ be a flat $R$-algebra homomorphism [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. In $A\otimes_R A$, put $r_i=1\otimes\psi(X_i)-\psi(X_i)\otimes1$ for $0\le i<d$. The list $(r_0,\ldots,r_{d-1})$ is weakly regular: multiplication by $r_i$ is injective on $(A\otimes_R A)/(r_0,\ldots,r_{i-1})$ for each $i$.
